coverage_assessment: First-pass open-web research is documented: 17 captured searches, 61 source cards, 14 body-read sources, 13 candidates, two exclusions, no verified continuations and 13 open gaps. Searches used weekly/date, regional and sector terms, predominantly in Spanish. This is not exhaustive and does not reproduce LexisNexis coverage; local-language, regional, attendance and episode-boundary gaps remain. Two candidates are proposed includes; remaining candidates are pending threshold or evidence. Official baseline remains pending.
